name: harvest-session-learnings
description: Scan the session and task artifacts for reusable lessons (what was tried, what failed and why, what surprised us) and propose entries to append to LEARNINGS.md, the produce-side counterpart to what task-init reads. Use on demand mid-task after a hard-won fix or surprising failure, or at closure to sweep a long session. Do not use to rewrite learnings, capture one observation (use capture-observation), close a slice or task (use slice-closure or task-close), or when nothing durable was learned (return NO_OP).
